values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included for campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/grass-point-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=447 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Looking to reserve a campsite for just 1 night? values.note: The park says its 20 electric sites each offer 20-amp service; ReserveAmerica's site list labels 17 of them in Sites 059-078 as 20-amp (5), 30-amp (8) and 50-amp (4). No water or sewer at the sites.

values.note: 72 campsites plus the Grass Point cottage; listed equipment lengths 20-40 ft (31 at 30 ft, 22 at 20 ft, 12 at 40 ft), all back-in.

summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 447): reservable (state:NY row, now on the entry), 9-month window incl. same day, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max; added 72 campsites to 40 ft (all back-in), 20 electric sites (park: 20-amp; RA's catalog labels some 30/50), no water or sewer at sites, showers, dump, drinking water.
